newer_changes_search: The cited PIB release of 4 Aug 2026 shows the scheme running with the same CFA; concessional loan rate now 5.75% (repo + 50 bp). No change to the CFA pattern or eligibility found.

findings.note: 'so you can get up to 300 units of electricity a month free' reads as an outcome promise; free units depend on system size and generation.
findings.suggestion: 'The scheme aims to give households up to 300 units of free electricity a month.' Mirror in hi.

findings.note: 'paid into your bank account after the system is installed and inspected': DBT is in the 2026 release, inspection is not in any snapshot. Document aadhaar cites 'portal', whose snapshot lists no documents.
findings.suggestion: Snapshot the portal's process text and cite it, or soften to 'after installation'.
